title: Value Males Belittle Females
synopsis: In many rural areas of China, having a son is preferred over having a daughter.

fullText.simplified:
中国的重男轻女现象

    最近，电视剧《都挺好》红遍中国。这部电视剧因为聚焦了“重男轻女”这个社会现象，所以引起了不少人的共鸣。该剧讲述了职场金领苏明玉从小不受家人待见，生长在家庭的边缘，在孤独扭曲的环境中长大成人的故事。苏明玉的母亲是个非常重男轻女的人，她可以花2000元给儿子去旅游，却不舍得花1000元给女儿苏明玉上补习班；她不惜卖房子也要供儿子去美国留学，却要求女儿去读不用交学费的师范大学，即使女儿的成绩很好，可以考取清华……
    在中国，“重男轻女”是一个很严重的社会问题。很多人，特别是生活在农村的人认为：嫁出去的女儿就像泼出去的水，传宗接代，养老送终，都只有儿子能做。所以他们可以不惜一切，只为生个儿子。如果你生下的是男孩，就会受到全家人的爱戴，但如果你生下的是女孩，老人家甚至都不会去看你和孩子一眼，还会说你的“肚子不争气，只会生女孩”。有些人会去做B超看看怀的是女孩还是男孩，如果是女孩，她们就会把她打掉，直到怀了男孩，才会把孩子生下来。为了阻止这样的事情发生，现在中国的法律规定：医生不能告诉孕妇胎儿的性别。因为人们的重男轻女观念，导致现在中国的男女比例严重失调。
    虽然随着如今教育的普及，重男轻女现象减少了很多，但在不少人的潜意识里，依旧会否定女性的价值。
fullText.traditional:
中國的重男輕女現象

    最近，電視劇《都挺好》紅遍中國。這部電視劇因為聚焦了“重男輕女”這個社會現象，所以引起了不少人的共鳴。該劇講述了職場金領蘇明玉從小不受家人待見，生長在家庭的邊緣，在孤獨扭曲的環境中長大成人的故事。蘇明玉的母親是個非常重男輕女的人，她可以花2000元給兒子去旅遊，卻不捨得花1000元給女兒蘇明玉上補習班；她不惜賣房子也要供兒子去美國留學，卻要求女兒去讀不用交學費的師範大學，即使女兒的成績很好，可以考取清華……
    在中國，“重男輕女”是一個很嚴重的社會問題。很多人，特別是生活在農村的人認為：嫁出去的女兒就像潑出去的水，傳宗接代，養老送終，都只有兒子能做。所以他們可以不惜一切，只為生個兒子。如果你生下的是男孩，就會受到全家人的愛戴，但如果你生下的是女孩，老人家甚至都不會去看你和孩子一眼，還會說你的“肚子不爭氣，只會生女孩”。有些人會去做B超看看懷的是女孩還是男孩，如果是女孩，她們就會把她打掉，直到懷了男孩，才會把孩子生下來。為了阻止這樣的事情發生，現在中國的法律規定：醫生不能告訴孕婦胎兒的性別。因為人們的重男輕女觀念，導致現在中國的男女比例嚴重失調。
    雖然隨著如今教育的普及，重男輕女現象減少了很多，但在不少人的潛意識裡，依舊會否定女性的價值。

sentences.english: To carry on the family line, and to look after old parents and bury them properly, are things only a son can do.

sentences.simplified: 还会说你的“肚子不争气，只会生女孩”。

sentences.english: In order to stop this kind of thing from happening, there is a legal requirement in China today:

sentences.traditional: 因為人們的重男輕女觀念，

sentences.english: A doctor cannot tell pregnant women the gender of the fetus.

sentences.simplified: 导致现在中国的男女比例严重失调。

sentences.pinyin: dǎo zhì xiàn zài zhōng guó de nán nǚ bǐ lì yán zhòng shī tiáo
sentences.english: Due to people’s idea that men are more important than women, ..
.. this has led to the men to women ratio in China today being seriously out of balance.

sentences.simplified: 虽然随着如今教育的普及，
sentences.traditional: 雖然隨著如今教育的普及，

sentences.simplified: 重男轻女现象减少了很多，

sentences.english: Although along with education being universal nowadays, ..

sentences.traditional: 但在不少人的潛意識裡，依舊會否定女性的價值。
sentences.pinyin: dàn zài bù shǎo rén de qián yì shí lǐ yī jiù huì fǒu dìng nǚ xìng de jià zhí
sentences.english: .. the phenomenon to consider men superior to women has decreased a lot.
But in the subconscious of not so few people, the value of women is still denied.

raw.synopsis: In many rural areas of China, having a son is preferred over having a daughter.
sentence_translations: The Chinese phenomenon of considering men superior to women
Recently, the TV drama “All is Well” is popular all over China.
Since this TV drama focuses on the social phenomenon “zhong nan qing nu”, it has sparked sympathy in a lot of people.
The show is about the office gold collar worker Su Mingyu who since childhood had not been seen by her family.
She was raised in the family’s periphery, and it is a story about growing up in lonely and distorted circumstances.
Su Mingyu’s mother is someone who strongly believes that men are more important than women.
She can spend 2000 yuan so her son can go on a trip, ..
.. but is reluctant to spend 1000 yuan so her daughter Su Mingyu can go to cram class.
She did not hesitate to sell an apartment to provide for her son to go to America and study abroad.
But she demanded that the daughter go study at the Normal University where no tuition fee is necessary, ..
.. even though the daughter’s grades are very good, and could pass the entrance examination to Qinghua University.
In China, “zhong nan qing nu” is a serious societal issue.
A lot of people, especially people who live in the countryside, believe that:
A daughter that has gone out to marry is like spill water.
To carry on the family line, and to look after old parents and bury them properly, are things only a son can do.
Therefore they only want to have a son at any cost.
If you give birth to a boy, then you are sure to receive the love of the whole family.
But if you give birth to a girl, none of the grandparents might even come to give you and your child a look.
They may even say that “your belly disappoints, it can only give birth to girls”.
Some people will take B-ultrasound to see if they have conceived a girl or a boy.
If it is a girl, they can abort her, and will only give birth when they conceive a boy.
In order to stop this kind of thing from happening, there is a legal requirement in China today:
A doctor cannot tell pregnant women the gender of the fetus.
Due to people’s idea that men are more important than women, ..
.. this has led to the men to women ratio in China today being seriously out of balance.
Although along with education being universal nowadays, ..
.. the phenomenon to consider men superior to women has decreased a lot.
But in the subconscious of not so few people, the value of women is still denied.
